image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate in an intertidal zone. The left side of the frame is dominated by the chiton's dorsal surface, showing distinct overlapping calcareous plates embedded in a textured girdle. The right side shows wet rocks, small pebbles, and possibly other marine organisms like barnacles or limpets.
